jp: \t\t厚手の茶色の紙で作られた封筒。差出人は書いていないが、手紙が添えられている。\n#～貰って嬉しい贈り物あれこれ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t厚手の茶色の紙で作られた封筒。差出人は書いていないが、手紙が添えられている。\n#～貰って嬉しい贈り物あれこれ～\n"
en: Envelope made of thick brown paper. The sender is not written, but a letter is attached. \n# ~Gifts that I am Happy to Receive~
en_grezzo: "Envelope made of thick brown paper. The sender is not written, but a letter is attached. \n# ~Gifts that I am Happy to Receive~"
it: Una busta fatta di carta marrone e spessa. Chi la manda non c'è scritto, ma insieme c'è una lettera. \n# ~Regali che Fa Piacere Ricevere~

jp: \t\t「ユニークなはく製を、惜しげもなく一般公開してくださってありがとうございます。真っ当に生きていたら見られないようなものばかりで、毎日のように興奮させていただいています。これからもユニークなはく製の収集を頑張ってください！」\n#～はく製マニアからの手紙～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t「ユニークなはく製を、惜しげもなく一般公開してくださってありがとうございます。真っ当に生きていたら見られないようなものばかりで、毎日のように興奮させていただいています。これからもユニークなはく製の収集を頑張ってください！」\n#～はく製マニアからの手紙～\n"
en: \"Thank you for generously opening up your unique collection of fossils to the public. They are things that we would not be able to see if we lived in a straight life, and they excite me every day. Keep up the good work in collecting these unique finds!\" \n# ~words of an Fossil Enthusiast~
en_grezzo: "\"Thank you for generously opening up your unique collection of fossils to the public. They are things that we would not be able to see if we lived in a straight life, and they excite me every day. Keep up the good work in collecting these unique finds!\" \n# ~words of an Fossil Enthusiast~"
it: \"La ringrazio d'aver aperto al pubblico, con tanta generosità, le sue statuette uniche. Sono tutte cose che una vita per bene non permetterebbe di vedere, e mi emozionano un giorno sì e l'altro pure. Continui così a raccogliere statuette uniche!\" \n# ~Lettera di un Fissato di Tassidermia~

jp: \t\t入っているカードはデッキに入れないと画像が反映されない。\n#～熱き決闘者たち～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t入っているカードはデッキに入れないと画像が反映されない。\n#～熱き決闘者たち～\n"
en: Pack of 5 collectible cards. The contained cards have no images, but can be putted into your deck.\n# ~Heated Duelists~
en_grezzo: "Pack of 5 collectible cards. The contained cards have no images, but can be putted into your deck.\n# ~Heated Duelists~"
it: Le carte che ci sono dentro non mostrano l'immagine finché non le metti nel mazzo.\n# ~Duellanti Ardenti~

jp: \t\t一部の地域では年の初めに知人へ贈る習慣がある。仲の良い相手にはそれだけ良いものを入れて贈るが、逆にそれほど仲の良くない相手にはイタズラを仕込むこともある。これのためだけに八方美人になる者もいるという。\n#～貰って嬉しい贈り物あれこれ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t一部の地域では年の初めに知人へ贈る習慣がある。仲の良い相手にはそれだけ良いものを入れて贈るが、逆にそれほど仲の良くない相手にはイタズラを仕込むこともある。これのためだけに八方美人になる者もいるという。\n#～貰って嬉しい贈り物あれこれ～\n"
en: In some regions, it is customary to give gifts to acquaintances at the beginning of the year. The gifts are filled with good things for those who are close to the recipient, but on the other hand, for those who are not so close to the recipient, a prank is sometimes played on the recipient. It is said that some people become a good person on all sides just for this reason. \n# ~Gifts that I am Happy to Receive~
en_grezzo: "In some regions, it is customary to give gifts to acquaintances at the beginning of the year. The gifts are filled with good things for those who are close to the recipient, but on the other hand, for those who are not so close to the recipient, a prank is sometimes played on the recipient. It is said that some people become a good person on all sides just for this reason. \n# ~Gifts that I am Happy to Receive~"
it: In certe zone c'è l'usanza di farne dono ai conoscenti all'inizio dell'anno. A chi si è amici ci si mette dentro roba buona in proporzione; a chi lo si è meno, invece, capita che ci si nasconda uno scherzo. Si dice che ci sia chi, solo per questo, si mette a fare il gentile con tutti. \n# ~Regali che Fa Piacere Ricevere~

jp: \t\t猫が入れられた箱。中の猫が生きているのか死んでいるのかは、この箱を開けてみないと分からないだろう。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t猫が入れられた箱。中の猫が生きているのか死んでいるのかは、この箱を開けてみないと分からないだろう。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Cat in a box. Whether the cat inside is alive or dead will not be known until the box is opened. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Cat in a box. Whether the cat inside is alive or dead will not be known until the box is opened. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Una scatola dentro cui è stato messo un gatto. Se il gatto lì dentro sia vivo o morto, non lo si saprà finché non si prova ad aprirla. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t「一握りの幸運者に極上の経験を！どちら様もロックピックを御持参して挑戦下さい」\n#～箱裏に書かれた注意書き～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t「一握りの幸運者に極上の経験を！どちら様もロックピックを御持参して挑戦下さい」\n#～箱裏に書かれた注意書き～\n"
en: \"A great experience for a handful of lucky people! Please bring your lockpicks to the challenge.\" \n# ~note written on the back of the box~
en_grezzo: "\"A great experience for a handful of lucky people! Please bring your lockpicks to the challenge.\" \n# ~note written on the back of the box~"
it: \"Un'esperienza sublime per una manciata di fortunati! Chiunque voglia tentare, si presenti col grimaldello\" \n# ~Avvertenza Scritta sul Retro della Scatola~

jp: \t\t食べ物を腐らせることなく保管できる機械仕掛けの箱。極めて便利な品物だが４種類しか入らないので、大勢でピクニックに行く時はご注意あれ。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t食べ物を腐らせることなく保管できる機械仕掛けの箱。極めて便利な品物だが４種類しか入らないので、大勢でピクニックに行く時はご注意あれ。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: A mechanical box that allows food to be stored without spoiling. Extremely useful item, but only holds four kinds of food, so beware if you are going on a picnic with a lot of people. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "A mechanical box that allows food to be stored without spoiling. Extremely useful item, but only holds four kinds of food, so beware if you are going on a picnic with a lot of people. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Una scatola a ingranaggi, che conserva il cibo senza farlo marcire. È comodissima, ma ci stanno solo quattro qualità di cibo: attenzione, quando si va a far merenda in molti. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t指定された税金を納める為の特別な箱。月に一度はパルミア大使館を訪れよう。\n#～打切上等！箱マニア・創刊号～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t指定された税金を納める為の特別な箱。月に一度はパルミア大使館を訪れよう。\n#～打切上等！箱マニア・創刊号～\n"
en: Special box for payment of designated taxes. Visit the Palmia Embassy to pay tax once a month. \n# ~Censored! Box Mania, First Issue~
en_grezzo: "Special box for payment of designated taxes. Visit the Palmia Embassy to pay tax once a month. \n# ~Censored! Box Mania, First Issue~"
it: Una scatola apposita, per versare le tasse dovute. Una volta al mese conviene fare un salto all'ambasciata di Palmia. \n# ~Chiudeteci Pure! Box Mania, Numero Uno~

jp: \t\t金属でできた巨大で頑強な枷。押しても引いてもびくともしないように見えるが、どうやら繋ぎ目が少し緩んでいるようにも見える。\n#～囚人達が選ぶ、人気商品ベスト５０～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t金属でできた巨大で頑強な枷。押しても引いてもびくともしないように見えるが、どうやら繋ぎ目が少し緩んでいるようにも見える。\n#～囚人達が選ぶ、人気商品ベスト５０～\n"
en: Huge, sturdy fetters made of metal. It does not seem to be affected by pushing or pulling, but the joints seem to be a little loose. \n# ~Top 50 Most Popular Products Among Prisoners~
en_grezzo: "Huge, sturdy fetters made of metal. It does not seem to be affected by pushing or pulling, but the joints seem to be a little loose. \n# ~Top 50 Most Popular Products Among Prisoners~"
it: Un ceppo di metallo, enorme e saldo. A spingerlo o a tirarlo pare non muoversi di un dito, eppure a guardarlo bene la giuntura sembra un po' allentata. \n# ~I 50 Prodotti Preferiti dai Detenuti~

jp: \t\t食材を半永久的に保管することができる叡智の結晶。しかしながら、この家具にはある秘密が存在する。なんと、何台所持していても扉の先は同じ空間にしか繋がらないのだ！\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t食材を半永久的に保管することができる叡智の結晶。しかしながら、この家具にはある秘密が存在する。なんと、何台所持していても扉の先は同じ空間にしか繋がらないのだ！\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: A work of wisdom that can store foodstuffs semi-permanently. However, there is a secret to this furniture. No matter how many units you own, their doors can only lead to the same space! \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "A work of wisdom that can store foodstuffs semi-permanently. However, there is a secret to this furniture. No matter how many units you own, their doors can only lead to the same space! \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Un frutto dell'ingegno, che conserva gli ingredienti quasi per sempre. C'è però un segreto in questo mobile: per quanti se ne posseggano, oltre lo sportello si arriva sempre e solo allo stesso spazio! \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t店の売り上げを一手に引き受ける特別な金庫。防犯の為、店以外の場所では決して開かないシステムになっている。\n#～脱冒険者から始める商いライフ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t店の売り上げを一手に引き受ける特別な金庫。防犯の為、店以外の場所では決して開かないシステムになっている。\n#～脱冒険者から始める商いライフ～\n"
en: A special safe that takes care of all the store's sales. For security purposes, the system is such that it can never be opened outside of the store. \n# ~Merchant Life Starting from a Quitting as a Adventurer~
en_grezzo: "A special safe that takes care of all the store's sales. For security purposes, the system is such that it can never be opened outside of the store. \n# ~Merchant Life Starting from a Quitting as a Adventurer~"
it: Una cassaforte apposita, che raccoglie tutto l'incasso del negozio. Contro i furti, è congegnata in modo da non aprirsi mai fuori dal negozio. \n# ~Vita da Mercante Dopo l'Avventura~

jp: \t\t店を経営するにおいて必要不可欠な金庫。ここに売上金が全て収められる。「不慮の事故で無くしてもご安心あれ。経済の要、パルミア大使館ですべて揃います」\n#～ティリス武具大全、広告のページ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t店を経営するにおいて必要不可欠な金庫。ここに売上金が全て収められる。「不慮の事故で無くしてもご安心あれ。経済の要、パルミア大使館ですべて揃います」\n#～ティリス武具大全、広告のページ～\n"
en: A safe is essential to running a store. This is where all sales proceeds are stored. \"If you lose it by accident, don't worry. Everything is available at the Palmia Embassy, the keystone of the economy.\" \n# ~Tyris Armor Compendium, page of advertisements~
en_grezzo: "A safe is essential to running a store. This is where all sales proceeds are stored. \"If you lose it by accident, don't worry. Everything is available at the Palmia Embassy, the keystone of the economy.\" \n# ~Tyris Armor Compendium, page of advertisements~"
it: Una cassaforte indispensabile per mandare avanti un negozio. Qui dentro finisce tutto l'incasso. \"Se un incidente ve la fa perdere, state tranquilli: all'ambasciata di Palmia, cardine dell'economia, si trova tutto\" \n# ~Grande Compendio delle Armi di Tyris: le Reclame~

jp: \t\t指定された品を納入する為の特別な箱。何でもかんでも投棄されないよう、投入口に少し工夫がなされているらしい。\n#～打切上等！箱マニア・創刊号～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t指定された品を納入する為の特別な箱。何でもかんでも投棄されないよう、投入口に少し工夫がなされているらしい。\n#～打切上等！箱マニア・創刊号～\n"
en: A special box for the delivery of designated items. It is said that a little effort is made at the slot to prevent wrong everything from being dumped. \n# ~Censored! Box Mania, First Issue~
en_grezzo: "A special box for the delivery of designated items. It is said that a little effort is made at the slot to prevent wrong everything from being dumped. \n# ~Censored! Box Mania, First Issue~"
it: Una scatola apposita, per consegnare la merce richiesta. Pare che la fessura abbia qualche accorgimento, perché non ci si butti dentro di tutto. \n# ~Chiudeteci Pure! Box Mania, Numero Uno~

jp: \t\t月に二回、得た給料を受け取る為の箱。不測の事態で箱を失っても給料はきちんと振り込まれる。しかし、パルミアの役人は融通が利かないということを憶えておくといいだろう。\n#～打切上等！箱マニア・創刊号～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t月に二回、得た給料を受け取る為の箱。不測の事態で箱を失っても給料はきちんと振り込まれる。しかし、パルミアの役人は融通が利かないということを憶えておくといいだろう。\n#～打切上等！箱マニア・創刊号～\n"
en: A box to receive the earned salary twice a month. Even if the box is lost due to unforeseen circumstances, the salary will be properly transferred. But remember that Palmia officials are inflexible, you need to buy another box from them. \n# ~Censored! Box Mania, First Issue~
en_grezzo: "A box to receive the earned salary twice a month. Even if the box is lost due to unforeseen circumstances, the salary will be properly transferred. But remember that Palmia officials are inflexible, you need to buy another box from them. \n# ~Censored! Box Mania, First Issue~"
it: Una scatola per ritirare la paga, due volte al mese. Anche se un imprevisto la fa perdere, la paga viene versata lo stesso; conviene però ricordarsi che i funzionari di Palmia non fanno sconti a nessuno. \n# ~Chiudeteci Pure! Box Mania, Numero Uno~

jp: \t\t古ぼけたカバン。その中には志半ばで大陸から去っていった者達の残した品々が収められている。受け取るには然るべき手続きを踏まなければならない。\n#～死にゆく者へ贈る書～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t古ぼけたカバン。その中には志半ばで大陸から去っていった者達の残した品々が収められている。受け取るには然るべき手続きを踏まなければならない。\n#～死にゆく者へ贈る書～\n"
en: An old briefcase. Inside the briefcase are items left behind by those who left the continent in the midst of their ambitions. To receive them, one must follow the proper procedures. \n# ~Book for the Dying Ones~
en_grezzo: "An old briefcase. Inside the briefcase are items left behind by those who left the continent in the midst of their ambitions. To receive them, one must follow the proper procedures. \n# ~Book for the Dying Ones~"
it: Una borsa vecchiotta. Dentro ci stanno le cose lasciate da chi se n'è andato dal continente a metà del cammino. Per averle bisogna passare per la trafila dovuta. \n# ~Libro in Dono a Chi Sta Morendo~

jp: \t\t何らかのアイテムが収められた球体。その中には「欲望」という名の希望が詰め込まれている。\n#～遊技大典・全年齢対応版～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t何らかのアイテムが収められた球体。その中には「欲望」という名の希望が詰め込まれている。\n#～遊技大典・全年齢対応版～\n"
en: Sphere containing some item. Inside it is filled with hope in the name of 'desire'. \n# ~Game Tricks, All Ages Version~
en_grezzo: "Sphere containing some item. Inside it is filled with hope in the name of 'desire'. \n# ~Game Tricks, All Ages Version~"
it: Una sfera in cui è stato riposto un oggetto qualunque. Dentro ci sta stipata una speranza che porta il nome di \"brama\". \n# ~Grande Compendio dei Giochi: Per Tutte le Età~

jp: \t\t何らかのアイテムが収められた球体。その中には「期待」という名の希望が詰め込まれている。\n#～遊技大典・全年齢対応版～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t何らかのアイテムが収められた球体。その中には「期待」という名の希望が詰め込まれている。\n#～遊技大典・全年齢対応版～\n"
en: Sphere containing some item. Inside it is filled with hope in the name of 'expectation'. \n# ~Game Tricks, All Ages Version~
en_grezzo: "Sphere containing some item. Inside it is filled with hope in the name of 'expectation'. \n# ~Game Tricks, All Ages Version~"
it: Una sfera in cui è stato riposto un oggetto qualunque. Dentro ci sta stipata una speranza che porta il nome di \"attesa\". \n# ~Grande Compendio dei Giochi: Per Tutte le Età~

jp: \t\t開けると素材が飛び出す黒い箱。多様な品が一気に飛び出すが、どうやってこの箱におさまっているのかは誰一人知らないという。\n#～打切上等！箱マニア・創刊号～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t開けると素材が飛び出す黒い箱。多様な品が一気に飛び出すが、どうやってこの箱におさまっているのかは誰一人知らないという。\n#～打切上等！箱マニア・創刊号～\n"
en: A black box that pops out materials when opened. A wide variety of items pop out all at once, but no one knows how they fit into this box. \n# ~Censored! Box Mania, First Issue~
en_grezzo: "A black box that pops out materials when opened. A wide variety of items pop out all at once, but no one knows how they fit into this box. \n# ~Censored! Box Mania, First Issue~"
it: Una scatola nera da cui, ad aprirla, saltano fuori i materiali. Ne esce di tutto in una volta sola, e si dice che come ci stiano dentro non lo sappia nessuno. \n# ~Chiudeteci Pure! Box Mania, Numero Uno~

jp: \t\t行商人が自ら苦労して集めた逸品が詰め込まれたカバン。防犯の為、登録者以外が開けると著しく不安を煽る魔法が掛けられているという。\n#～脱冒険者から始める商いライフ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t行商人が自ら苦労して集めた逸品が詰め込まれたカバン。防犯の為、登録者以外が開けると著しく不安を煽る魔法が掛けられているという。\n#～脱冒険者から始める商いライフ～\n"
en: A briefcase filled with the best goods that a peddler has worked tirelessly to collect. For security purposes, the bag is said to be enchanted with a spell that makes people feel extremely guilty if anyone other than the registered owner opens it. \n# ~Merchant Life Starting from a Quitting as a Adventurer~
en_grezzo: "A briefcase filled with the best goods that a peddler has worked tirelessly to collect. For security purposes, the bag is said to be enchanted with a spell that makes people feel extremely guilty if anyone other than the registered owner opens it. \n# ~Merchant Life Starting from a Quitting as a Adventurer~"
it: Una borsa piena dei pezzi pregiati che un mercante ambulante ha raccolto con la propria fatica. Contro i furti, si dice porti addosso una magia che a chi la apre, e non sia l'intestatario, mette dentro un'inquietudine fortissima. \n# ~Vita da Mercante Dopo l'Avventura~

jp: \t\t「おやこんな所に財布が。良かった、無くなったかと思って心配していたんだ。こないだ無くした自分のものと似てるって？そりゃそうだよ、何故なら僕は沢山財布を持ってるから」\n#～ならずもののオネストの言葉～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t「おやこんな所に財布が。良かった、無くなったかと思って心配していたんだ。こないだ無くした自分のものと似てるって？そりゃそうだよ、何故なら僕は沢山財布を持ってるから」\n#～ならずもののオネストの言葉～\n"
en: \"Oh, I found a wallet here. Good, I was worried it might be lost. You say I look familiar? That's right, 'cause I have a lot of wallets.\" \n# ~words of the honest? rogue~
en_grezzo: "\"Oh, I found a wallet here. Good, I was worried it might be lost. You say I look familiar? That's right, 'cause I have a lot of wallets.\" \n# ~words of the honest? rogue~"
it: \"Oh, un portafoglio qui. Meno male, ero in pena perché credevo d'averlo perso. Dici che somiglia a quello che hai perso tu l'altro giorno? Ma certo che sì: è perché di portafogli io ne ho tanti\" \n# ~Parole di <Onest> il farabutto~

jp: \t\t「このカバンは自分のものだ。いや、昔持っていたんだ。いや、持っていた記憶がある、いや、買いたかった－、いや待てよ。ああそうだ思い出した、どこかの老紳士が置いたカバンだった。つまりは自分のものだ」\n#～こそどろのグリドの言葉～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t「このカバンは自分のものだ。いや、昔持っていたんだ。いや、持っていた記憶がある、いや、買いたかった－、いや待てよ。ああそうだ思い出した、どこかの老紳士が置いたカバンだった。つまりは自分のものだ」\n#～こそどろのグリドの言葉～\n"
en: \"This bag belongs to me. No, I used to have it. No, I remember I had it, no, I wanted to buy it - no, wait. Oh yes, I remember, it was a bag that some old gentleman put there. In other words, it belonged to me.\" \n# ~words of <Gleed> the thief~
en_grezzo: "\"This bag belongs to me. No, I used to have it. No, I remember I had it, no, I wanted to buy it - no, wait. Oh yes, I remember, it was a bag that some old gentleman put there. In other words, it belonged to me.\" \n# ~words of <Gleed> the thief~"
it: \"Questa borsa è mia. Anzi no, ce l'avevo tempo fa. Anzi, mi ricordo d'averla avuta; anzi, la volevo comprare... anzi, aspetta. Ah, ecco, mi è tornato: era la borsa che aveva posato lì un vecchio signore. E dunque è mia\" \n# ~Parole di <Gleed> il topo d'appartamento~

jp: \t\t「中に希望が入っているか、それとも絶望か。ただ一つだけ分かることは、保管している人間にとっては絶望でしかないことだろうね」\n#～稀代の怪盗『マークス』の言葉～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t「中に希望が入っているか、それとも絶望か。ただ一つだけ分かることは、保管している人間にとっては絶望でしかないことだろうね」\n#～稀代の怪盗『マークス』の言葉～\n"
en: \"Is there hope inside, or is it despair? I guess the only thing I know is that for those who keep it, it's all despair.\" \n# ~words of <Marks> the great thief~
en_grezzo: "\"Is there hope inside, or is it despair? I guess the only thing I know is that for those who keep it, it's all despair.\" \n# ~words of <Marks> the great thief~"
it: \"Dentro c'è la speranza, oppure la disperazione? L'unica cosa che si può sapere è che per chi la tiene chiusa lì non sarà altro che disperazione\" \n# ~Parole di <Marks>, ladro senza pari~

jp: \t\t主にネフィアに安置されているというアイテムの保管された箱。解錠できなかった冒険者が力任せに強奪していかないように非常に重く作られている。\n#～打切上等！箱マニア・創刊号～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t主にネフィアに安置されているというアイテムの保管された箱。解錠できなかった冒険者が力任せに強奪していかないように非常に重く作られている。\n#～打切上等！箱マニア・創刊号～\n"
en: A box containing items that are said to be mainly kept in Nephia. The boxes are made to be very heavy so that adventurers who cannot unlock them will not be able to rob them by brute force. \n# ~Censored! Box Mania, First Issue~
en_grezzo: "A box containing items that are said to be mainly kept in Nephia. The boxes are made to be very heavy so that adventurers who cannot unlock them will not be able to rob them by brute force. \n# ~Censored! Box Mania, First Issue~"
it: Una scatola che custodisce oggetti, e che si dice stia soprattutto nelle Nefia. È fatta pesantissima, perché l'avventuriero che non riesce ad aprirla non se la porti via a forza. \n# ~Chiudeteci Pure! Box Mania, Numero Uno~

jp: \t\t宝飾品で彩られた輝く宝箱。見た目に反して以外と軽く、外装の煌びやかさも手伝って小物入れとして購入していく客もいるようだ。\n#～打切上等！箱マニア・創刊号～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t宝飾品で彩られた輝く宝箱。見た目に反して以外と軽く、外装の煌びやかさも手伝って小物入れとして購入していく客もいるようだ。\n#～打切上等！箱マニア・創刊号～\n"
en: A shining treasure box decorated with jewelry. Despite its appearance, it is surprisingly lightweight, and some customers seem to buy it as a glamorous accessory box. \n# ~Censored! Box Mania, First Issue~
en_grezzo: "A shining treasure box decorated with jewelry. Despite its appearance, it is surprisingly lightweight, and some customers seem to buy it as a glamorous accessory box. \n# ~Censored! Box Mania, First Issue~"
it: Un baule splendente, ornato di gioielli. Contro le apparenze è insolitamente leggero, e con quel rivestimento sfavillante pare che ci siano clienti che lo comprano per tenerci le cianfrusaglie. \n# ~Chiudeteci Pure! Box Mania, Numero Uno~

jp: \t\t「俺はずっとここで盗品の品定めをしているが、過去に二度程驚いたことがある。一度目は黄金の巨神像を持ってきたマスターに。そして二度目は、財宝の中身ではなく外身を持ってきたお前のような奴にだ」\n#～盗賊ギルドの番人『アビス』の言葉～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t「俺はずっとここで盗品の品定めをしているが、過去に二度程驚いたことがある。一度目は黄金の巨神像を持ってきたマスターに。そして二度目は、財宝の中身ではなく外身を持ってきたお前のような奴にだ」\n#～盗賊ギルドの番人『アビス』の言葉～\n"
en: \"I've been here all my life, sifting through the stolen goods, and I've been surprised twice in the past. The first time was by a gentleman who brought me a golden statue of a giant god. The second time was to a man like you who brought not the contents of the treasure, but its bejeweled exterior.\" \n# ~words of <Abyss> the thief watchman~
en_grezzo: "\"I've been here all my life, sifting through the stolen goods, and I've been surprised twice in the past. The first time was by a gentleman who brought me a golden statue of a giant god. The second time was to a man like you who brought not the contents of the treasure, but its bejeweled exterior.\" \n# ~words of <Abyss> the thief watchman~"
it: \"Io sto qui da sempre a stimare la refurtiva, e in tutto questo tempo mi sarò stupito sì e no due volte. La prima per il maestro, che mi portò una statua d'oro di un gigante. La seconda per uno come te, che della refurtiva mi ha portato non il dentro, ma il fuori\" \n# ~Parole di <Abyss> il guardiano della Gilda dei Ladri~
